title: Failure/success mining tool (MIE-0004 first slice)
summary: orchestrate mining clusters FAIL and SUC records by signature and reports occurrences, open count, task families, coverage, and the signatures that need coverage (open, recurred >=2, no regression test or experiment link). Deterministic, no model call. On the current store: 4 failure signatures, all resolved, 0 coverage gaps. It gives the improvement loop a standing check that recurring failures reach a regression case and an experiment (constitution section 8).

prior_art.reused: signature-cluster idea; taxonomy borrowed earlier for FAIL signatures
prior_art.why_custom: operates on Agent OS's own typed records; no dependency
